# Hosts the agent CLIs and build tools reach at RUN TIME (login, inference, model
# catalogues, dependency resolution), as opposed to the installer hosts in
# workspace/agent/testdata/installer-egress-hosts.txt. On an enforcing egress gateway a host
# missing from defaultEgressAllowlist breaks that kind with nothing pointing at the cause.
#
# Read by egress_runtime_hosts_test.go (control-plane): defaultEgressAllowlist admits every
# plain line, admits no "!" or "-" line, and every destination tag exists in
# internal/agentroutes/catalog.json.
#
# Format, whitespace separated:   [!|-]host  kinds  destination  evidence   # comment
#   kinds        comma-separated agent kinds (catalog.json "kinds"), or "build" for build tools
#   destination  a catalog.json destination id: the tag ADR 0138 M4 (#4171) uses to drop the
#                host of an excluded destination; "-" = never dropped (build tooling)
#   evidence     measured: seen on a production gateway in log-only (#4392)
#                docs: from vendor docs or the CLI's own sources, never observed here
# "!" = needed but deliberately left to the admin (general-purpose upload endpoint).
# "-" = looked at and left out: telemetry or cosmetic traffic the CLI does not need.
#
# Hosts are exact. A vendor-wide suffix (.googleapis.com, .google.com) would admit
# storage.googleapis.com; the one suffix in the defaults is .claude.com, matching the
# existing .claude.ai and .anthropic.com.

# Claude Code (.claude.com is a default suffix; the measured hosts are listed individually)
platform.claude.com        claude    anthropic   measured
claude.com                 claude    anthropic   measured
code.claude.com            claude    anthropic   measured

# codex
chatgpt.com                codex     openai      measured   # ChatGPT sign-in backend
auth.openai.com            codex     openai      docs       # codex login
api.openai.com             codex,opencode openai docs       # openai-api route

# agy (Antigravity): backend and Google sign-in
daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com agy google     measured
cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com agy      google      docs       # non-daily channel
accounts.google.com        agy       google      measured
oauth2.googleapis.com      agy       google      measured
www.googleapis.com         agy       google      measured
# agy side traffic, left out: the sign-in page renders in the member's own browser, not in
# the CLI, so static assets and the avatar are not needed; play.googleapis.com is
# telemetry and antigravity-unleash.goog is feature flags, which a CLI fails open on.
# Unmeasured either way: if enforce shows agy needing one, move it up with evidence.
-www.gstatic.com           agy       google      measured
-lh3.googleusercontent.com agy       google      measured
-play.googleapis.com       agy       google      measured
-antigravity-unleash.goog  agy       google      measured
!storage.googleapis.com    agy       google      docs       # agy install/update; admin adds it

# opencode
models.dev                 opencode  opencode.ai measured   # model catalogue (third-party host)
models.opencode.ai         opencode  opencode.ai measured
opencode.ai                opencode  opencode.ai docs       # zen / account routes

# Build tools (no agent kind, no destination)
plugins.gradle.org         build     -           measured
repo.maven.apache.org      build     -           measured
services.gradle.org        build     -           docs       # Gradle wrapper download

# copilot, cursor, kiro, muse: docs-only
api.githubcopilot.com      copilot   github      docs
api.individual.githubcopilot.com copilot github  docs
api2.cursor.sh             cursor    cursor      docs
authenticator.cursor.sh    cursor    cursor      docs
authenticate.cursor.sh     cursor    cursor      docs
app.kiro.dev               kiro      kiro        docs
prod.us-east-1.auth.desktop.kiro.dev kiro kiro    docs
q.us-east-1.amazonaws.com  kiro      kiro        docs       # already inside .amazonaws.com
api.meta.ai                muse      meta        docs       # api_base_url written by muse login
auth.meta.com              muse      meta        docs       # device-code login
